messages:
jordan: Heads-up — I prototyped a tiny CLI wrapper around deploy-bot to (1) generate standardized release notes, (2) pin service versions in repo, and (3) run a simulated rollback. Dry-run works. gist: https://gist.github.com/xyz (quick example). Thoughts?

mira: Nice. Can it enforce change-window rules? we should block prod deploys outside the window unless explicit override + audit note.

jordan: Yes — plan is to default-block in prod and add `--override --audit-note "reason"` to permit. Example: `deploy-assist --service api --image sha:abc123 --canary 5 --dry-run`.

sam: Also add a "rollback triggers" checklist in the generated release notes (error rate, p99 latency, user-impact). makes post-deploy decisions consistent.

release-bot: deploy-bot: preflight OK for api@sha:abc123 — canary policy: 5% -> 25% over 10m, auto-scaling disabled for canary. To proceed: `/deploy confirm api sha:abc123 --canary 5`.

kevin: Where do we persist the pins? DB or repo?

jordan: Repo — `configs/pins/<service>.yaml` with {image: sha, pinned_at, pinned_by}. Script will open PR when pinning and can auto-merge on CI green. Keeps audit trail.

ops-qa: Make rollback idempotent. `deploy-assist --rollback-to sha:old` should inspect current pin and abort if already at target. Also include post-rollback verification steps.

mira: Agreed. Also add a small release-note template: ```
Summary:
Impact:
DB changes (yes/no):
Feature flags:
Rollback plan:
Monitoring links:
Rollback triggers (metric thresholds):
SLO impact:
```

sam: UX ask — have the bot post the generated notes as an ephemeral message to the releaser and also open a PR under `release-notes/` so it's easy to paste into GH releases.

jordan: Will do. Adding `--generate-notes` to post ephemeral + channel announcement and open the PR. Also adding `--sign` to attach a signed tag to the pinned file.

release-bot: Reminder: prod change window Tue-Fri 10:00-18:00 UTC. Overrides require `--audit-note` and 2 approvals.

kevin: :thumbsup: let's smoke-test on staging: `deploy-assist --staging --image sha:abc123 --dry-run` tomorrow.

jordan: I'll open the PR tonight with docs, sample commands, and a tiny demo workflow. If no objections, I'll merge after reviews and a green staging test.

mira: No objections from me — make sure ops has the rollback playbook linked in the notes.

ops-qa: Will test rollback idempotency and the audit-note flow during the staging test.

release-bot: Note: all deploy-assist actions requiring overrides will create an audit log entry in `infra-audit` with the provided note.
